channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Putin’s nuclear briefcase makes surprise appearance at China summit
item.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin’s nuclear briefcase was spotted at the APEC summit in China.

item.title: Four killed as Russian strikes hit Ukraine’s Odesa
item.description: At least four people have been killed and thirteen more injured after Russian strikes hit Ukraine’s port city of Odesa.

item.title: Israeli settler kills Palestinian grandmother in occupied West Bank
item.description: A Palestinian grandmother was killed by an Israeli settler in the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Kuwait, Bahrain face new Iran attacks after US strike on Qeshm Island
item.description: Iranian attacks on the Gulf countries draw condemnation from across the region.

item.title: Israeli military launches rare ground operation in Gaza beyond Yellow Line
item.description: Hamas condemns the incursion, which the Israeli military says is dismantling a "terror tunnel", as a "flagrant" ceasefire violation.

item.title: Kuwait says it repelled first Iranian attack in two months after US strikes island
item.description: Bahrain says it was also attacked by Iran following a US air strike on the Iranian island of Qeshm in the Gulf on Tuesday.

item.title: Pakistani man sentenced to 27 years for Iran-backed plot to kill Trump
item.description: Asif Merchant was found guilty in March of trying to hire undercover FBI agents as hitmen to assassinate US officials, including the president.

item.title: US loses measles elimination status after 26 years amid record case numbers
item.description: States have reported over 5,400 cases and 10 measles-related deaths for the first time since the early 1990s.

item.title: Palestinian woman, 72, shot dead by Israeli settlers in West Bank, health ministry says
item.description: Palestinians say there was an attack by settlers in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, while the Israeli military says the settlers fired after being attacked.
